desc:
Chewits Strawberry Juicy Bites are irresistibly tasty bonbon‑style sweets with a soft, chewy shell and a juicy, strawberry‑flavoured liquid centre. Bursting with fruity sweetness and a subtle tang, each bite delivers a little flavour adventure that fans of sweet‑and‑sour treats will love.

Chewits · Bites · Fruity
ingredients:
STRAWBERRY FLAVOURED SWEETS FILLED WITH STRAWBERRY FLAVOURED LIQUID

Ingredients:

sugar, glucose syrup, vegetable fats (palm, coconut), humectant (E420), maltodextrin, acids (E330, E270), natural flavouring, emulsifier (E473), fruit juice from concentrate (apple, lemon, strawberry, orange, pineapple, peach), salt, colour (E162), concentrate from (carrot, blackcurrant), acidity regulator (E325.

May contain MILK, NUTS and PEANUTS.
